text:
Samir: hey all :wave: quick Q as I'm going through onboarding — where should I post questions about repo access, infra perms, and which bots to invite? also, do we prefer threads or DMs for followups?
Mira (People Ops): hi Samir — welcome! For access/perms: post in #help first so engineers can triage, include your team name and repo. If it's sensitive, DM me or @security. For bots, ping #devex or follow the guide in the onboarding doc. :raised_hands:
Olivia (DevEx): +1 Mira. Also please use threads under the root help post instead of spamming the channel. Short followups in thread, direct DMs for single-person questions.
Samir: got it — is there a quick command to invite the common bots (ci-bot, devex-bot) to my workspace or do I need an admin?
Ben: you can self-install devex-bot in most channels. Click Apps -> search 'devex-bot' -> Add to channel. CI bot usually needs a repo admin to connect. If you hit a perms error, paste the screenshot here and we'll escalate.
Samir: ok — tried to add devex-bot to #samir-test and got "You don't have permission to add apps" error.
Olivia (DevEx): can you run `/invite @devex-bot` in that channel and paste the output? sometimes Slack shows the specific missing permission.
Samir: ran it, output: "Cannot invite this app — workspace admin required" (screenshot pasted)
Mira (People Ops): I'll open a ticket with IT. @it-ops-can we approve a temporary app install for new hires for devex-bot? ticket 1234.
Ben: meanwhile, as a workaround, you can DM me the channel name and I’ll add it for you.
Samir: thanks! also what's the etiquette for using @here in small channels like #satellite-engineering? ok to ping for quick sync?
Olivia (DevEx): avoid @here in >30 person channels. In 5-20 person channels ok if it's urgent. Use `:warning:` and tag specific people when possible.
devex-bot: Installed devex-bot in #samir-test by Ben — try `/devex help` to see available commands.
Samir: confirmed, `/devex help` returns commands. Thanks everyone! :smile:
Ben: welcome aboard :tada: ping if anything else.
